keyword.en: what voltage does the concrete pump catalogue print
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵目录印了多少伏

title.en: Which Concrete Pump Prints a Rated Voltage
title.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了额定电压

description.en: Among Xingtai concrete pumps, only B500S-83D prints 380 V. Other electric rows print motor kilowatts and leave voltage blank.
description.zh: 在邢台混凝土泵里，只有 B500S-83D 印了 380 V。其他电动行印电机千瓦，电压留空。

h1.en: Which Concrete Pump Prints a Rated Voltage
h1.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了额定电压

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints a rated voltage on one concrete pump in the Xingtai catalogue: B500S-83D, 380 V, beside a 7.5 kW motor. Electric 10, Electric 15, Electric 20, Electric 40, Electric 60 and Electric 80 print motor kilowatts and do not print volts or frequency. Do not copy 380 V onto those pages. A motor kilowatt line is not a supply-voltage line.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵目录里只给一台机器印了额定电压：B500S-83D 为 380 V，旁边是 7.5 kW 电机。电动10、电动15、电动20、电动40、电动60和电动80印电机千瓦，不印伏特或频率。不要把 380 V 抄到那些页面。电机千瓦行不是供电电压行。

body.en: B500S-83D's type line says two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. The rated-voltage cell is 380 V. The motor-power cell is 7.5 kW. The page does not print a second voltage for the manual setting. Hebei Pinjin Machinery gives this concrete pump its own page in Xingtai.
body.zh: B500S-83D 的型式行写两级结构泵，手动/电动。额定电压格是 380 V。电机功率格是 7.5 kW。页面没有为手动档再印一个电压。河北品锦机械在邢台给这台混凝土泵单独的页面。

heading.en: Electric rows that stop at kilowatts

body.en: Electric 80 prints 110 kW and no voltage. Electric 10 prints 15 kW and no voltage, even though it is a compact electric machine like B500S-83D. The absence is the fact. Spraying-machine pages that print 380 V are not concrete pump rows and do not fill this gap.
body.zh: 电动80印 110 kW，没有电压。电动10印 15 kW，没有电压，尽管它和 B500S-83D 一样是紧凑电动设备。缺失本身就是事实。喷涂机页面上的 380 V 不是混凝土泵行，也不能填这个空。

heading.en: What to send when voltage is blank
heading.zh: 电压为空时要提供什么

body.en: The contact page asks for site voltage and frequency when you inquire. That request does not invent a voltage on the pump sheet. Send the model plus the site supply through /en/contact/.
body.zh: 联系页在询盘时要求提供现场电压和频率。这个要求并没有在泵的参数页上编造电压。请通过 /zh/contact/ 发送型号和现场电源。

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 110 kW. It does not print a rated voltage.
answer.zh: 没有。电动80印 110 kW。它不印额定电压。

answer.en: B500S-83D. The cell is labelled rated voltage.
answer.zh: B500S-83D。这一格的标题是额定电压。

question.en: Does the manual setting have its own voltage?
question.zh: 手动档有单独的电压吗？

answer.en: The page does not print one. It prints 380 V once, next to 7.5 kW.
answer.zh: 页面没有另印。它只印一次 380 V，旁边是 7.5 kW。

question.en: Is a kilowatt figure a voltage?

answer.en: No. Motor power and rated voltage are different cells. Only one of them is on most electric pages.
answer.zh: 不是。电机功率和额定电压是不同的格子。多数电动页只有其中一项。
